description: Reference Hermes-first Marketing flow: local project confirmation, Marketing department selection, five question bundles, Ads + Content Creation proposals, atomic materialization, design graph, and starter fixtures.

project.description: A local growth workspace for designing Hermes-routed marketing loops.
project.primaryGoal: Improve qualified acquisition and content throughput without unsafe automation.
project.sourceOfTruth: HubSpot defines qualified leads/customers; Notion contains approved content briefs.

answers.source_of_truth: HubSpot defines qualified leads and customers; Notion contains approved content briefs.
answers.event_sources_subjects: Hermes receives Google Ads campaign anomaly events keyed by campaign ID and Notion content brief approvals keyed by page ID.
existing_automations: Slack notifications for campaign review reminders

answers.trigger_or_cadence: Campaign anomalies, weekly review cadence, and approved content briefs.
answers.problem_signal: Campaign spend rises while qualified customer conversion drops.
answers.pain_type_severity: Manual context gathering and slow draft review are high severity.
answers.baseline: 6 hours per week of review prep and 3 days average draft cycle time

answers.read_write_boundary: Read data and write drafts only; no publishing or spend changes without approval.

answers.guardrail_metric: lead quality and brand safety must not decline
answers.baseline_target: Reduce review prep from 6 hours to 2 hours per week and draft cycle time from 3 days to 1 day.
verification_rules: review packets include owner and approval threshold

answers.urgency_priority: Campaign spend anomalies above threshold win over routine content work; independent approved content work can proceed separately.
answers.pilot_scope: two campaigns and one content channel
